message.content:
This is a washable kraft paper bag with textile handles, printed. Paper bags fall under heading 4819 (cartons, boxes, bags of paper), and printed ones are classified there rather than in chapter 49 when the printing is incidental to the bag's use. Within 4819.30 are sacks and bags with a base width of 40 cm or more, while 4819.40 covers other sacks and bags, including envelopes. Because the base is 25.5 cm wide, it goes in 4819.40.

The bag could be considered "washable kraft paper," which might raise questions about whether it is a textile-like material. The description says it is paper made of wood pulp treated with waterproofing and strengthening agents, so it remains paper and stays in 4819.

The statistical suffix for 4819.40.00 is 4819.40.0000, with no further subdivision.
